title: zehra ke bhare ghar ka matam hai azadaro
body:
zehra ke bhare ghar ka matam hai azadaro
karbal ke bahatar ka matam hai azadaro
1. yeh aaho buka kya hain yeh farshe aza kya hain
yeh sibte payambar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
2. pamal huwa ran mein jo ghodou ki tanpo se
uss dilbar -e- shabbar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
3. shabbir bohat roye lashey pe baradar ke
abbas -e- dilawar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
4. bhoolenge bhala kaise duniya ali akbar ko
hum shakle payambar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
5. haaton pe shahe deen ke jo teer -e- sitam khaaya
uss nanhe se asghar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
6. islam pe ehsan jis laasha e- be sarka
uss laasha -e- besar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
7. zindan mein soti hain nazon ki pali bachi
shabbir ki dukhtar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
8. tatheer ke waris ke they log tamashayi
zainab ke khule sar ka matam hain azadaro
<<MINI>>
zehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . . .
<<DIVIDER>>
9. roti hai fareed ab tak zehra jisse maqtal mein
us kushtaye khanjar kazehra ke bhare ghar ka . . . .
